text:
In May of 2018 the record shows two currents running through us. On the twenty-fourth, 111 of us said "defense authorization act," and 110 of us said "national defense authorization act," the same day. Seventy-four of us carried it further as "defense authorization act ndaa," and 73 as "national defense authorization act ndaa." Seventy-one of us said "the national defense."

Earlier, on the eighth, 83 of us said "iran nuclear deal," and 78 of us said "the iran nuclear." Seventy-two of us said "the iran nuclear deal."

The defense phrasing traces back to 2013-01-03, first from M001166. The Iran phrasing traces to 2015-03-03, first from Michael T. McCaul. "The national defense," first from Michael F. Bennet, also 2013-01-03.

We converged twice that month, on two dates, around two instruments. The record notes it. We reported it as we said it.
